channel.title: Contentful incidents — Vendor Status Watch
channel.description: Incidents from Contentful's public status page, polled daily.

item.title: Stale entries on Content Delivery API [resolved]
item.description: We identified the source of the issue which caused some items which were purged to get stuck in cache. We have complete a full cache purge in the EU and the issue is now resolved.

item.title: Daily audit logs outage [resolved]
item.description: The issue is resolved and audit logs are delivered as expected again.

item.title: Issues with Space Add-ons [resolved]
item.description: We have implemented a fix and the issue has been resolved.

item.title: Experience API experiencing issues on upsert operations [resolved]
Errors on Content Management API [resolved]
Increased latency and error rates for Snapshots [resolved]
Errors on requests to Contentful from Frankfurt (FRA) region [resolved]
item.description: We have taken action and error rates have returned to normal.

item.title: Errors on Contentful Content Management and Preview APIs. [resolved]
Latency and errors using Content Model Templates [resolved]
Periodic errors and latency spikes on Contentful Management and Preview APIs. [resolved]
item.description: Due to an issue identified with an external provider a small portion of customer traffic may have experienced periodic spells of higher latency or timeouts / errors when making requests to the Contentful Management and Contentful Preview APIs in the past few days (26th to 29th June) - the issue has been resolved

item.title: Connection issues with the Management and Preview APIs [resolved]
Cloudinary asset picker not working [resolved]
item.description: The asset picker in the Cloudinary Marketplace app was not working. The issue is resolved. Customers may need to do a hard refresh to clear their browser cache.

item.title: Issues with full-text search and locale-based publishing for some EU customers [resolved]
Issues with content editing and publishing for some EU customers [resolved]
Optimization Hub Unavailable [resolved]
item.description: We have resolved the underlying issue, the Optimization Hub is available again.

item.title: Issues with file uploads [resolved]
item.description: We think the impact from the issue is over, however, uploads using 3rd cloud providers (Google Drive, Instagram, Box, Dropbox etc) are temporarily disabled.

item.title: Issues with the Contentful Web App [resolved]
The Rich Text Editor is intermittently failing to render for some users [resolved]
item.description: We've spotted that something has gone wrong. We're currently investigating the issue, and will provide an update soon.

item.title: Resolved - The Rich Text Editor is intermittently failing to render for some users [resolved]
item.description: We've spotted that something has gone wrong. We're currently investigating the issue, and will provide an update soon.

item.title: Increased error rates on Content Management API [resolved]
Audit logs incomplete for days ranging between 30 of April and 4th of May. [resolved]
item.description: We've recovered the logs for all customers for the affected dates and these have been sent through to customer storage.

item.title: Some customers are experiencing issues logging in [resolved]
Issues accessing spaces/environments in the Contentful web app [resolved]
Customers experiencing issues with Workflows [resolved]
500 errors on Contentful APIs [resolved]
Customer's content not surfacing in the Contentful web app [resolved]
Some web app components inaccesible [resolved]
item.description: We have completed the rollout of the fix and believe all organizations should have restored functionality.

item.title: Customers unable to access Organisation settings [resolved]
item.description: We have validated that the fix resolved the issue and customers are no longer seeing errors when accessing the org settings page in the Contentful WebApp.

item.title: SSO login errors [resolved]
Optimization hub not rendering [resolved]
